# cubus.sh

> cubus.sh is an interactive, canvas-based gateway to the cubus.sh web presence.

The home page presents a three-dimensional visual navigation interface. It is a
static site and does not expose an API, authentication flow, or documentation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cubus.sh/): Interactive visual navigation.
- [About](https://about.cubus.sh/): About page linked from the home page.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/hanmyeonglee/cubus.sh): Source code for the home page.
